items.question: How fast do you respond?
items.answer: A senior engineer reviews your message and responds within one business hour. If you send a voice note or form outside business hours, we'll get back to you the next business day.

items.question: What do I need to provide to get started?
items.answer: Just tell us what you need in your own words: a voice note, a form, or an email. You don't need technical documents or specifications. We ask the right questions during the conversation.

items.question: What if I don't know anything about technology?
items.answer: You don't need to. We speak plain language and take care of translating your needs into a technical solution. Your part is telling us what your business needs; ours is finding the best way to make it happen.

items.question: Who actually does the work?
items.answer: The company owners. No account managers, no handoffs: the two people you talk to are the same ones building the solution. You always know who you're working with.

items.question: What happens after the first contact?
items.answer: We review what you shared, propose a 30-minute call to better understand your situation, and deliver a clear roadmap with options in under 2 days.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside Mexico?
items.answer: Yes. We work with businesses in Mexico, the United States, and Canada. Most of our work is done remotely with video call meetings.

items.question: Can I cancel at any time?
items.answer: Yes. No trapping contracts. Each phase has a clear scope and you decide whether to continue with the next one.

items.question: Is there support after project delivery?
items.answer: Yes. We offer support and maintenance options based on what you need. We don't leave you alone after delivery.

services.carlosRabagoQuote: I like to find simple solutions for complex problems. Listening, understanding, and building something stable always ends up giving better results.

about.title: About - CROW SYSTEMS
about.description: Two technology professionals, company owners, building reliable systems for local and mid-size businesses in Mexico, the United States, and Canada.
about.heading:
We're two technology professionals
who take the time to understand your business
about.description1: Crow Systems was born from the frustration of watching businesses waste money on expensive consultants and software that doesn't deliver. One engineer specializes in networks, infrastructure, and secure communications. The other builds backend systems, data pipelines, and APIs. Together, we cover everything your business needs: no account managers, no handoffs, just the people who actually do the work.
about.description2: We work directly with business owners who need real engineering expertise without the overhead of a big firm. When you work with us, you work with the owners: two professionals who will treat your business as if it were their own.
about.missionText: To give growing businesses direct access to technology professionals who own the company: no intermediaries, no excuses, just reliable systems built by the people who stand behind them.
about.visionText: Technology should help businesses, not slow them down. Every company, regardless of size, should have the engineering expertise it needs to grow with confidence.
valueItems: Honest answers, even when it's hard
Built to last, not to flip

privacy.title: Privacy Policy - CROW SYSTEMS
privacy.description: Read the Privacy Policy for Crow Systems to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Crow Systems collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our website and services.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: Crow Systems respects user privacy and is committed to protecting personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, used, and protected when you visit our website or engage our consulting services.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
sections.intro: We may collect the following information:
items: Name and company information
Email address and phone number
Consultation and project details
Audio submissions (if provided)
Technical browser and device information
Website usage analytics

sections.title: 3. How Information Is Used
sections.intro: Collected information may be used to:
items: Respond to inquiries and consultation requests
Provide and improve our consulting services
Improve website functionality and user experience
Process submissions and manage projects
Send requested communications and updates
Maintain security and reliability of our systems
sections.extra: Crow Systems does not sell personal information to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Audio Submission Handling
sections.content: Audio recordings submitted through the website may be temporarily stored and processed for consultation review purposes. Users should avoid submitting highly sensitive, confidential, or regulated information unless a formal agreement is in place.

sections.title: 5. Cookies & Analytics
items: Essential cookies for site functionality
Performance analytics
Anonymous usage tracking
sections.extra: Analytics data is used to improve user experience and website performance.

sections.title: 6. Third-Party Providers
sections.content: Crow Systems may use third-party providers for hosting, file storage, form processing, analytics, and email delivery. These providers process data according to their own privacy policies and applicable regulations.

sections.title: 7. Data Security
sections.content: Crow Systems implements reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect submitted information. This includes encryption of data in transit and at rest. However, no online system can guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 8. Data Retention
sections.content: Information is retained only as long as necessary for business operations, legal obligations, service delivery, and security monitoring. Unused or outdated information may be periodically deleted.

sections.title: 9. User Rights
items: Access to their personal information
Correction of inaccurate data
Deletion requests where applicable
Communication preferences updates
sections.extra: Requests may be submitted to privacy@crowsys.chrislabs.net.

sections.title: 10. International Users
sections.content: Users accessing the website from outside the operating region acknowledge that information may be processed in jurisdictions different from their own, in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

sections.title: 11. Children's Privacy
sections.content: The website and services are not intended for children under 13 years of age. Crow Systems does not knowingly collect information from children.

sections.title: 12. Changes to Privacy Policy
sections.content: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

sections.title: 13. Contact Information
sections.content: Questions regarding privacy may be directed to privacy@crowsys.chrislabs.net.

terms.title: Terms of Service - CROW SYSTEMS
terms.description: Read the Terms of Service for Crow Systems technology consulting services and website usage.
terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Please read these terms carefully before using our website or services.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing or using the Crow Systems website and services, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these terms, you should not use the website or services.

sections.title: 2. Services
sections.content: Crow Systems provides technology consulting, advisory services, digital solution planning, and related professional services. Services include systems consulting, IT infrastructure, software solutions, technical strategy, digital transformation, and automation consulting. All services are provided subject to availability and project scope agreements.

sections.title: 3. Use of Website
items: Use the website lawfully and in accordance with these terms.
Avoid submitting malicious, abusive, or misleading content.
Avoid attempting unauthorized access to systems or infrastructure.
Avoid misuse of forms, APIs, or upload systems.
Provide accurate and complete information when submitting inquiries or requests.
sections.extra: Crow Systems reserves the right to block or restrict access to abusive users.

sections.title: 4. Consultation Requests
sections.content: Submitting a consultation request does not establish a formal business relationship or contractual agreement. Project work, pricing, timelines, and deliverables require separate written agreements. Our team will review your submission and respond within 1 business hour.

sections.title: 5. Audio Submissions
sections.intro: Users may voluntarily submit audio recordings through the website. By submitting audio content, users confirm:
items: They own or have rights to the submitted content.
The content does not violate laws or third-party rights.
The content does not contain malicious or prohibited material.
sections.extra: Crow Systems reserves the right to reject or remove inappropriate submissions. Audio recordings are handled securely and used solely for consultation review purposes.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All website content, branding, design elements, text, graphics, and materials are the property of Crow Systems unless otherwise stated. Users may not reproduce, distribute, or reuse materials without prior written permission.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.intro: Crow Systems is not liable for:
items: Indirect or consequential damages
Business interruption or loss of profits
Data loss
Third-party service outages
Temporary website unavailability
sections.extra: All services are provided on an "as available" basis.

sections.title: 8. Third-Party Services
sections.content: The website may integrate with third-party providers including hosting, form processing, storage, analytics, and communication platforms. Crow Systems is not responsible for third-party service interruptions, policies, or data handling practices.

sections.title: 9. Privacy
sections.content: Use of the website is also governed by our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 10. Changes to Terms
sections.content: Crow Systems may update these Terms of Service periodically. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of updated terms.

sections.title: 11. Contact
sections.content: Questions regarding these Terms may be sent to legal@crowsys.chrislabs.net.

systemsConsulting.title: Systems Consulting
systemsConsulting.description: Your team stops wasting time between tools that don't talk to each other.
systemsConsulting.fullDescription: Fragmented tools, disconnected departments, and manual processes that no longer scale cost your business time and money. We audit how you work with technology, identify where things get stuck, and deliver a clear plan to unblock your team. The result: less wasted time, fewer errors, and more time focused on serving your customers.
features: Your team works without losing time between systems
Tools that connect to each other seamlessly
Processes that scale when your business grows
Clarity on which tools you need and which to cut
Reports that help you make better decisions
systemsConsulting.idealFor: Businesses spending time and money on manual processes, unintegrated tools, or duplicated effort across teams.
systemsConsulting.cta: I want my team to work better

itInfrastructure.description: Your business always available for your customers, without interruptions.
itInfrastructure.fullDescription: Infrastructure is the foundation everything depends on: if it goes down, your business goes down. We build networks, servers, cloud environments, and recovery plans that keep your business online: even when more customers need you. From AWS to on-prem, we build foundations that grow with your business, not against it.
features: Your business always online, no downtime
Your data secure and protected at all times
Infrastructure that grows when your business grows
Fast response to any issue
Constant monitoring to prevent failures
itInfrastructure.idealFor: Businesses that depend on always being online, handle sensitive data, or are growing and need infrastructure that scales with them.
itInfrastructure.cta: I want my business to never stop

technicalStrategy.title: Technical Strategy
technicalStrategy.description: Clear technology decisions so you invest wisely with no surprises.
technicalStrategy.fullDescription: Every technology decision has long-term consequences. We help you see clearly and make informed decisions about what to build, what to buy, and where to invest. No sales pitches, no trends: just solid engineering judgment that balances speed with sustainability. We translate your business goals into clear technical plans and make sure you own your own destiny.
features: You know exactly where to invest and what to avoid
Clear decisions on build vs. buy
Avoid costly technology surprises
Your systems are ready to grow
You choose the right tools for your business
technicalStrategy.idealFor: Business owners and leaders who need to make technology decisions without a full in-house technical team.
technicalStrategy.cta: I want to make better tech decisions

digitalTransformation.title: Digital Transformation
digitalTransformation.description: Modernize what matters and make decisions based on real data.
digitalTransformation.fullDescription: Digital transformation gets a bad name because it usually means 'replace everything.' We do it differently: we modernize the systems that matter most and connect your data into a single source of truth. The result is dashboards you can trust, reports that actually help, and a team that makes decisions in hours instead of weeks. No unnecessary disruption, just practical progress.
features: You make decisions based on data, not guesses
Clear reports that help you understand your business
Modern systems that don't slow your operations
Your team has the information they need, when they need it
Less time searching for data, more time using it
digitalTransformation.idealFor: Established businesses with aging systems looking to modernize, unlock data insights, and improve decision-making speed.
digitalTransformation.cta: I want decisions based on real data

automationConsulting.description: Eliminate repetitive manual work so your team focuses on what really matters.
automationConsulting.fullDescription: Repetitive manual work is a silent killer of productivity. We identify the highest-impact opportunities to eliminate it: from deployment pipelines to data entry. The result: your team is freed from repetitive tasks and can focus on the creative, strategic work that really moves the needle for your business.
